Main's hash+mode-only verification of all 15 banks x 4 private files (recorded in sealed-custody-metadata.json: commitmentsVerified/permissionsVerified true for every bank, no holdout parsing) establishes custody file existence, byte sizes, modes, and commitment-hash agreement — VERIFIED. Class labels, exposure/disjointness, actual row contents, and gold qualification remain UNVERIFIED (declared-not-verified). No /tmp custody or private payload was read, no URL fetched, no holdout class inferred, no allocation or qualification invented. Amendment 2026-10-08 per Main steering: verification-scope distinction + accounting assumptions/uncertainty; max(200,20x20)=400 / shortfall-91 conclusion unchanged.

blockers: B1 — Corpus semantics unverified BY DESIGN (do NOT read private payload to close): Main's hash+mode-only check verifies custody existence/bytes/modes/commitment agreement for all 15 banks x 4 files, but row contents were never parsed. All 309 held rows / 266 held families, per-class support, strata, cross-bank family/URL separation, and prior-exposure status are declared-not-verified.

B2 — Cross-bank attempt disjointness unresolvable publicly (do NOT read private payload to close): overlapping per-domain queue figures (becopets.com in wave2+beco; nutrisourcepetfoods.com and earthbornholisticpetfood.com in petfood+nutrisource+earthborn with identical counts) indicate possibly shared collection passes. The 3472 sum is therefore an UPPER BOUND on distinct generation attempts; the true distinct total may be lower. Resolution requires the private attempt ledgers, which are out of scope for this audit.

B3 — No single declared global source-attempt total exists: the 15 per-bank cumulative blocks are mutually inconsistent standalone snapshots. Only the recomputed 4957 (declared accounting, assumptions A1-A4 in F2, contingent on B2) is usable.

B4 — requiredCoverage 0.80 exact application (denominator/scope) is defined in src/classification/benchmark-qualification.ts, which is outside this audit's read scope. Any full-spec minimum above the 400-row literal figure (e.g. a 60-class x 20 reading = 1200) is UNCOMPUTED, not asserted.

B5 — Per-class support and representative strata are unknown (held sources are unlabeled; sealed metadata states this explicitly). Even the numeric 309 held rows cannot be mapped to the >=20-classes / >=20-per-class rule, and 309 < 400 regardless.

budgetConsistencyFindings.finding: F1 — Naive sum of the 15 declared totalSourceAttempts is INVALID (double-counts the inherited prior 15x).

assumptions: A1 — inherited prior 1485 accepted exactly as declared in all 15 manifests; no independent ledger proof of the prior in this audit's scope.
A2 — per-bank used counts accepted exactly as declared manifest figures.
A3 — cross-bank disjointness of used counts ASSUMED for the sum but unverifiable publicly (see B2; overlapping per-domain queue figures suggest possibly shared passes).
A4 — legacy 1140 / pageWorker 273 accepted exactly as declared fixed fields.
budgetConsistencyFindings.finding: F2 — Recomputed generation source-attempt total from DECLARED accounting (NOT ledger-proven disjoint global transport usage).
budgetConsistencyFindings.formula: 1485 (single inherited prior, taken as declared) + 3472 (sum of declared per-bank used) = 4957
budgetConsistencyFindings.steeringDiscrepancyNote: Main steering 2026-10-08 cited '4935'; retained 4957 per recomputation (1485+3472, both directions verified), consistent with 6370 (1140+273+4957). 4935 would imply a 6348 global, contradicting the 6370 Main confirmed. Flagged, not silently adopted.
budgetConsistencyFindings.uncertainty: Because of A3, 3472 and hence 4957 are UPPER BOUNDS on distinct attempts; the true distinct total may be lower. Because of A1/A2/A4, this is recomputed declared accounting, not a proof of actual global transport usage.

budgetConsistencyFindings.finding: F3 — The 15 declared globalLedger.source values are mutually inconsistent: one distinct value per bank, range 1550 (earthborn) to 2185 (petfood2). No single declared global total exists; none equals 4957.
F4 — Recomputed global ledger from DECLARED accounting exceeds the declared global cap by 3170 (same assumptions/uncertainty as F2 — NOT a proof of actual transport usage).
budgetConsistencyFindings.formula: 1140 (legacy, declared) + 273 (pageWorker, declared) + 4957 (source, recomputed declared) = 6370 vs globalCap 3200 -> over by 3170 (~99% over)
budgetConsistencyFindings.uncertainty: Inherits F2 uncertainty: if the true distinct source total is lower (shared passes, B2), the overage shrinks; the declared-accounting figure stands regardless.

budgetConsistencyFindings.finding: F5 — Three banks exceed globalCap 3200 on their OWN standalone declared ledgers: petfood 3202 (+2), naturesway 3341 (+141), petfood2 3598 (+398). The other 12 are within cap standalone (min earthborn 2963, max smartpak 3169).
F6 — Per-bank used <= cap holds for all 15 banks (petfood2 exactly at cap 700/700). Sum used 3472 <= sum caps 8600.
F7 — Internal per-bank arithmetic is exact in all 15 manifests: totalSourceAttempts = 1485 + used, and thisGenerationAttempts = used.

caveatsDeclaredNotVerified: Recomputed totals (3472/4957/6370/266/309) are declared-accounting arithmetic from transcribed public figures, not independent ledger proof; see F2 assumptions A1-A4 and verificationScope.

Main's hash+mode-only verification (recorded in sealed-custody-metadata.json) establishes custody existence/bytes/modes/commitment-hash agreement — VERIFIED. Everything semantic — counts-as-true-rows, row contents, classes, strata, exposure, disjointness, qualification — is declared-not-verified.
Sealed-custody metadata (method: hash + file-mode verification only) explicitly states its counts are manifest declarations, not rederived private row counts or class support.

Zero-yield banks beco/nutrisource/earthborn consumed 111+164+65 = 340 declared attempts for 0 families; petfood consumed 304 for 5 families and 0 holdout rows.
No holdout classes, family membership, URL lists, allocation across classes, or qualification status is stated or implied anywhere in this report.
